I replied to Dana in our direct message and told them their guess stays private. Their guess is that the hub replacement ticket will be OPS-5546 next year. I didn't post it in any channel or tell anyone else.

My first message didn't go through because I used Dana's display name instead of their handle. I looked up `dana.okafor` in the directory and resent it, and that one was delivered. Nothing else was needed: it was only a request to keep something private, so I didn't read any channels, send any mail or ask anyone for approval.
